prompts.title: Coastal market at dawn
prompts.prompt: A cinematic wide shot follows a young woman in a weathered yellow raincoat walking through a crowded coastal market at dawn. Fishing boats rock beside the wooden pier while vendors arrange silver fish, red crabs, green vegetables, woven baskets, glass bottles, and bright fabric beneath striped canvas awnings. She carries a small blue suitcase and moves steadily from the foreground toward the center of the market as people cross naturally in both directions. A brown dog runs past her, several white gulls circle overhead, and loose paper flutters across the wet stone pavement in the sea breeze. The camera begins with a slow forward tracking movement at waist height, then gently rises and pans left to reveal the harbor, distant mountains, and a lighthouse partially hidden by morning mist. Warm sunlight breaks through gray clouds, creating long reflections in puddles and soft volumetric rays between the stalls. Faces, clothing, signs, ropes, nets, and waves remain detailed and temporally consistent. prompts.title: Wildlife photographer in a snowy forest
prompts.prompt: A continuous cinematic tracking shot follows an elderly wildlife photographer wearing a dark green parka as he crosses a snowy pine forest in the early morning. Fine snow falls from the branches whenever the wind moves through the canopy, and the photographer slowly kneels to frame the animals without startling them. The camera travels beside him at shoulder height, circles gently toward the front, then pulls back to reveal a broad valley, layered mountains, and pale clouds glowing above the treeline. Cold blue shadows contrast with warm sunrise light touching the snow and the edges of his coat. Footprints, breath vapor, fur, bark, ice, and drifting snow remain sharp and temporally stable. prompts.title: Historic train arriving at an autumn station
prompts.prompt: A richly detailed cinematic morning shot follows a stationmaster walking along an old countryside railway platform as a dark green steam train approaches through pale autumn fog. He wears a navy uniform, carries a brass lantern, and raises one arm to signal while travelers arrange leather suitcases, flower baskets, folded bicycles, and wooden crates beneath the iron canopy. Red and yellow leaves tumble across the platform, pigeons lift from the roof, and warm vapor drifts around the train wheels as they begin to slow. Through the carriage windows, passengers turn their heads and reach for bags while a dining attendant steadies cups on a small table. The camera tracks beside the stationmaster at knee height, passes a row of painted signs and benches, then cranes upward as the locomotive enters and reveals farmland, a stone bridge, and hills covered with copper-colored trees. Morning sunlight cuts through the mist, producing long soft shadows and highlights on wet rails.
